- Department / Division
- Incident Date
- Incident Time
- Incident Shift

## Location Specific
- Company location - Where
- Job description

## Nature Of Incident
- (e.g., was it Hit, struck by, exposure to, fire, sparks, or other?)

# From injury record

## Injury Seen To
- (e.g., was it fingers, arm, eye, leg, & was it dominant or non-dominant?)
- Body part - Right, Left both? Only record one in this field.

## Diagnosis
- (e.g., was it laceration, broken bone, etc.?)
- Injury/illness
